args: const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const root=process.cwd();const save=path.join(root,'build','publish-attempts','boss-tools-approval-repair-20261010-95719eae');fs.mkdirSync(save,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});for(const file of ['build/integration-sources.json','build/integration-output/integration-artifacts.json']){const target=path.join(save,path.basename(file));if(!fs.existsSync(target))fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root,file),target,fs.constants.COPYFILE_EXCL);}const data=execFileSync('git',['-C','/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/worktrees/afc-c16-team-guidance','show','0fa0b73a849b96494e1b891eeb7f461ec06476ee:build/integration-sources.json'],{encoding:'utf8'});const pins=JSON.parse(data);if(pins.sources.bossfang.revision!=='95719eaefc491e6d19c84ed7bf0b7d62632d8d0b')throw Error('Producer BossFang source mismatch');fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'build/integration-sources.json'),data);

args: const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/var/folders/ln/0wnpd96j26z2qhvx9m6hwt2r0000gn/T/boss-integrated-publisher-EkroF9/build/published-boss-tools-approval-repair-20261010-95719eae/integration-artifacts.json','utf8'));const f=path.join(process.cwd(),'build/integration-artifacts.json');const current=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));const incoming=m.tools.find(x=>x.name==='bossfang');const old=current.tools.find(x=>x.name==='bossfang');if(!incoming||!old)throw Error('BossFang record missing');for(const key of ['darwin-arm64','win32-x64']){const p=incoming.packages[key];if(p?.source?.revision!=='95719eaefc491e6d19c84ed7bf0b7d62632d8d0b'||p.source.repository!=='GQAdonis/librefang'||!p.url.startsWith('https://github.com/Prometheus-AGS/the-boss/releases/download/boss-tools-approval-repair-20261010-95719eae/'))throw Error('Repaired BossFang provenance mismatch');}const updated={...current,tools:current.tools.map(x=>x.name==='bossfang'?{...x,version:incoming.version,packages:{...x.packages,'darwin-arm64':incoming.packages['darwin-arm64'],'win32-x64':incoming.packages['win32-x64']}}:x)};fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(updated,null,2)+'\n');
